app.name: Baraka
app.tagline: Halal, doctor and accountant in one app

auth.title: Welcome to Baraka
auth.subtitle: Sign in to start
auth.error: Sign-in failed. Please check your credentials and try again.
auth.blocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups and retry.
auth.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured. You can register with email or try as a guest.

consent.title: Consent to data processing
consent.body: To analyse food, medicine and your money, Baraka needs your explicit consent. Your data stays attached to your account only and is never shared.
consent.health: I agree to the processing of my health data (age, weight, conditions, medicines).
consent.finance: I agree to the processing of my financial data (income, expenses, balances).

onboarding.title: Let's complete your profile
onboarding.localStorage: Secure storage strictly under your sovereign control.

health.incomplete: Add at least your age and weight to use the doctor.

halal.title: Halal check
halal.subtitle: Photograph the ingredients, the pack or the barcode
halal.scanning: Sheikh AI is reading the ingredients…
halal.cached: Saved result from a previous check
halal.empty: Send a photo or some text to start
halal.disclaimer: This is a helpful opinion, not a fatwa. For disputed matters ask qualified scholars.

chats.title: Chats
chats.emptyHint: Start from a halal check, the doctor or the accountant.
chats.stopped: The stream stopped. You can retry.

doctor.title: Doctor AI
doctor.subtitle: Photo of medicine, food or a lab test — I'll explain
doctor.profileGate: Complete your health profile first so the answer fits your situation.
doctor.emergencyBody: Call 112 now. This app does not provide emergency care.
doctor.exercise: To burn it you need about
doctor.disclaimer: Information only — not a diagnosis or a prescription. See a doctor.

accountant.title: Accountant AI
accountant.redBody: At this rate your money runs out on {{date}} — {{days}} days before payday.
accountant.reviewHint: Edit any line, then save. Expenses are stored as negative.
accountant.duplicateHint: A similar expense already exists around that time.
accountant.chatHint: Ask about your plan or anything money related
accountant.label: Name
accountant.disclaimer: The accountant is informational: it never moves money and gives no binding investment advice.
accountant.step1: Stop every non-essential purchase today; buy only the basics.
accountant.step2: Postpone or split one fixed payment this week.
accountant.step3: Set a small daily cash cap until payday.

profile.title: Profile
profile.ownHint: Any compatible provider. Your key is sent with each request through our server, never stored or logged, and saved only on this device.
profile.deleteHint: Your Google account, all data and images will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteWarning: Warning: All your data, check history, and budget records will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

errors.unauthorized: Session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.ai_unavailable: The assistant is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.ai_auth_failed: The assistant is unavailable (server setup). Please inform the admin.
errors.ai_parse_failed: I could not read that confidently. Try a clearer photo.
errors.device_pending: This device is waiting for admin approval.

install.title: Install Baraka
install.body: Add Baraka to your home screen to use it like a native app.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.android: On Android: browser menu, then "Install app".

alerts.sharia: A helpful opinion, not a fatwa.
alerts.medical: Informational only, not a diagnosis or prescription.
alerts.financial: Estimates for planning, not binding financial advice.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: You can browse saved chats and history, but analysis needs a connection.

guest.localOnly: Your data stays on this device only
guest.signInToSave: Sign in with Google to keep your data
guest.limits: Guests get {{count}} AI requests per day
guest.upgradeBody: We found guest data on this device. Move it into your account?
guest.exitBody: Everything saved on this device will be erased permanently.
guest.demoApplied: Ready! Try the red plan and the doctor
guest.expired: Guest session expired. Please start again.
guest.noExport: Export is available after signing in.
guest.noDelete: Account deletion is available after signing in.

guest.aiRequiresAuth: AI screening and consultations require a registered account. Please sign in or create an account to proceed.

onboarding2.slide1Body: Scan or paste food and medicine ingredients to receive a clear dietary ruling with reasons.
onboarding2.slide2Body: Analyze medicines and foods against your personal health profile, allergies, and safety warnings.
onboarding2.slide3Body: Track daily expenses, compute a daily spending limit, and stay in control until your next payday.
onboarding2.consentBody: We process health and money data only with your consent, stored in your account (or on this device in guest mode).
onboarding2.guestNote: You can try it first as a guest, without signing up.

home.salam: Peace and blessings be upon you

home.discussHint: You can object and add what you know

profile2.motionHint: Your device setting is respected too

landing.headline: Halal Living & Disciplined Personal Budgeting
landing.description: Instant halal screening of food and medicine ingredients, paired with intelligent personal budgeting for conscious consumers in Russia with privacy and precision.
landing.cap1Desc: Instant photo and text screening of food and medicine labels with clear dietary verdicts.
landing.cap2Desc: Track daily spending limits, expense flow, and balance through each salary cycle.
landing.cap3Desc: Allergy alerts and medicine safety considerations matched to your health profile.
